statement: A recurrent, context-aware TraderDecisionPolicy (MarketBelief + 28 expert evidence + sovereign OpportunityBook + position thesis + portfolio allocation) changes costed net R per campaign on the development slice relative to the V8 incumbent policy, beyond what a random-entry arm with matched exits and a simple control policy achieve.

intervention.description: V9 adaptive decision policy, shadow-evaluated then costed native replay

matched.opportunity_exposure: same canonical opportunity set and identical exit policy per matched pair
matched.exit_policy: native bracket: 2% protective stop / 4% target, stop-first on ties

control_arms.description: V8 incumbent volume-confirmed breakout policy (native baseline)

matched.opportunity_exposure: same canonical opportunity set and identical exit policy per matched pair
matched.exit_policy: native bracket: 2% protective stop / 4% target, stop-first on ties

control_arms.description: Random entries on the same calendar with matched exits, costs and exposure

matched.opportunity_exposure: same canonical opportunity set and identical exit policy per matched pair
matched.exit_policy: native bracket: 2% protective stop / 4% target, stop-first on ties

control_arms.description: Single deterministic rule baseline (trend filter only) with matched costs

matched.opportunity_exposure: same canonical opportunity set and identical exit policy per matched pair
matched.exit_policy: native bracket: 2% protective stop / 4% target, stop-first on ties

unit_of_comparison: per-campaign net R (net PnL / bracket risk), equal-weighted
decision_rule: PASS is earned only by costed evidence: a V9 arm whose net-R exceeds the best matched control with a bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero after the registered Holm correction. Otherwise NO_EDGE, INCONCLUSIVE, STOP or INVALID. Sealed OOS is a separate, authorized evaluation.
